{{Oracle/Calculations/u1}}

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|oracle_false_promise}}
** For affected {{M|invulnerable}} allied heroes at the end of the duration, the ability effects are applied whenever the ally becomes vulnerable.
** Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
** Grants the following bonuses upon cast:
*** Applies a {{M|strong dispel}}.
*** {{M|Damage negation}} ([[Damage Manipulation|after most reductions]]), preventing certain {{M|on-damage effects}} proc, except the following sources:
**** {{M|Instant kill}} sources.
**** Max {{M|health}} bonuses from {{M|strength}} sources.
**** [[Setting health]] sources.
*** {{Symbol|bonus t1l}} Flat {{M|bonus armor}}.
**** The {{ValueColor||bonus armor|10tal}} {{M|talent|t=t1l}} immediately update the current instance.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability on Oracle.
** Reapplying the buff refreshes its duration, but it neither refreshes the damage counter nor the heal counter.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# Applies two counters simutaneously as follows while the buff is active.
*#* [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|a|Counter}} {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}}
*#** The damage counter accumulates all damage instances applied ([[Damage Manipulation|after reductions]]) of all [[damage type]]s to the buff-affected allied hero sequentially.
*#* [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|a|Counter}} {{Symbol|bonus hprestore}} {{Symbol|bonus regen-hp}}
*#** All valid heal instances ({{Code|h}}) applied to the affected allied hero is summed up, and applies its heal counter factor, and is defined as:
*#*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|h {{=}} Σ([[Heal]] + HP[[Health Regeneration|Regen]]) × {{#var:False Promise value2}}}}
*#** Considers only the following health restoration sources:
*#*** {{M|Heal}} sources.
*#*** {{M|Health regeneration}} sources.
*# Checks if {{Code|h > ΣDamageReceived}} at the end of the ability duration.
*# Subtracts the damage instances applied sequentially from {{Code|h}}, and is defined as:
*#* {{Code|h - Damage<sub>1</sub> - Damage<sub>2</sub> - Damage<sub>3</sub> - ... - Damage<sub>n</sub>}}
*#* If the {{Code|h}} depletes, False Promise now applies the damage instance sequentially, with the following damage properties and flags:
*#** {{Symbol|Modifier|Flag}}
*#*** {{M|HP Removal}} flag.
*#*** [[Damage Types#No-multiplier|No-multiplier]] flag, and does not interact with [[Damage Manipulation#Generic Damage Manipulator|generic damage manipulation]] sources.
*#** Does not change the properties of non-lethal damage instances.
*#** The following {{M|damage negation}} sources interact as per normal with the damage applied:
*#*** {{A|Templar Assassin|Refraction}}
*#*** {{A|Visage|Gravekeeper's Cloak}}
*#* {{Symbol|Death}}
*#** If the affected allied hero [[dies]] from the damage instance, False Promise grants the kill credit to the damage instance source that kills the buff affected allied hero.
*#** {{M|Deny|text=Denies}} the affected ally if the kill credit is given to an ally.
*# If all damage instance are {{M|damage negation|text=negated}}, applies the remaining {{Code|h}} as a single {{M|heal}} instance to the affected allied hero.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
** The {{#var:Ice Blast basic2}}-{{M|projectile speed}} tracer has the following properties:
*** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
**** Grants a non-lingering 500-radius centered around the {{M|projectile}} as it travels.
*** {{Symbol|fx|v}} {{Symbol|fx|s}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
**** The following ability components are visible and audible ally-only:
***** The {{M|cast point}} sound effects.
***** The tracer {{M|projectile}} both in-game and on the minimap.

* All ability components consider {{M|clones}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes, and {{M|illusions}} as creeps.

* The {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|ice_blast}} has two main debuff application methods:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}} {{A|Ancient Apparition|Release}}
*** Applies the debuff on enemy heroes coming in contact with the released projectile.
*** Hence, the [[projectile]] does not apply the debuff if {{Symbol|a|Sub}} {{A|Ancient Apparition|Release}} is not used as the tracer reaches the map boundary.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}} {{Symbol|Target|Area-Dummy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Aura}}
*** The ability effects are applied as follows at the impact radius:
***# Creates a negative [[aura]] at the impact radius that applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|ice_blast}}.
***#* {{Symbol|a|up}}
***#** The explosion radius increases per traveling second, and is defined as:
***#*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|ΣRadius {{=}} {{#var:Ice Blast value2}} + {{#var:Ice Blast value4}} per second , MAX {{=}} {{#var:Ice Blast value3}}}}
***#** Hence, the tracer projectile reaches its max radius after a {{Code|{{#expr:ceil(({{#var:Ice Blast value3}}-{{#var:Ice Blast value2}})/{{#var:Ice Blast value4}})}}-second}} travel duration or a {{Code|{{#expr:{{#var:Ice Blast basic2}}*ceil(({{#var:Ice Blast value3}}-{{#var:Ice Blast value2}})/{{#var:Ice Blast value4}})}}-distance}} to reach max radius.
***#* The non-lingering debuff expires immediately when leaving the impact effect radius, and reapplies the debuff when reentering the radius.
***# {{cf|shdnotes}} Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|ancientapparition_[[Ancient Apparition#Cold Feet|coldfeet]]_freeze}} of its corresponding level upon impact.
***#* Works independently of {{A|Ancient Apparition|Cold Feet}}'s {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
***#* Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
***# The impact {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
***# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{A|Ancient Apparition|Bone Chill}}

* Applies the following ability effects on {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|ice_blast}} debuff-affected enemy heroes:
** The [[Restoration Manipulation#Health Freeze|Health Freeze]] component.
*** Checks the debuff-affected unit's {{M|current health}} per {{M|heal}} instance or per damage instance taken, excluding {{M|HP Removal}} sources, then applies the following ability effects if their health drops below the threshold:
***# {{M|Death dispel|text=Death dispels}}.
***#* This dispels most debuffs applied before applying the next ability component.
***# The {{M|instant kill}} component, and credits the kill to the damage source which brought the affected unit's current health to the instant kill health threshold.
***#* However, with self-damage sources, Kaldr is credited instead.
***#* The following sources prevent affected enemy units from being instant killed:
***#** {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.
***#** [[Min health]] sources.
*** Affects the following units:
**** {{M|Spell immune}} units.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*** Does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*** Negates the following {{M|current health}} increasing sources:
**** Both flat and percentage-based current health sources.
**** Current health increase from {{M|strength}} items and/or from health bonus items.
**** {{A|Ancient Granite Golem|Granite Aura}}.
*** Does not interact with the following mechanics:
**** [[Setting health]] sources.
**** Max health increasing sources.
**** Upon {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{A|Timbersaw|Whirling Death}} expiring.
**** Upon {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{A|Undying|Decay}} expiring.
